scientific_name: Exhaustive binned box least-squares transit search
common_name: Exhaustive binned box least-squares transit search
scientific_use: Search transit phase and duration for every supplied trial period.
scientific_purpose: Search transit phase and duration for every supplied trial period.

source_references.title: Astropy Box Least Squares and Kovacs, Zucker, Mazeh (2002)
Berkeley SoftFloat: software IEEE arithmetic methodology (no code copied)

canonical_equations: bin=floor((time mod P)*K/P); canonical per-bin count and flux sums; scan start then width; positive depth=out_mean-in_mean; score=depth^2*n_in*n_out/N; greatest score, earliest start/width on exact score ties
input_contract: encoding=binary32-hex; times[N] uint ticks0..10000000, flux[N]binary32,N2..4096; periods[F]integers1..1000000,F1..128; bins2..64; min_width1..max_width<=bins-1; F*(N+bins^3)<=2000000
output_contract: F x[status,start_bin,width_bins,depth,out_of_transit_mean,score]; status1=no positive valid dip and remaining words zero; bins wrap; equal observation weights; no continuous phase/duration optimization
result_contract: F x[status,start_bin,width_bins,depth,out_of_transit_mean,score]; status1=no positive valid dip and remaining words zero; bins wrap; equal observation weights; no continuous phase/duration optimization
precision_requirements: Finite IEEE binary32 values, explicitly supplied as eight hex digits (encoding=binary32-hex). Every +,-,*,/,sqrt rounds to nearest ties-to-even; gradual underflow; canonical positive zero after arithmetic. No FMA or reassociation. Nonfinite inputs, intermediate overflow, division by zero and invalid roots reject the job on CPU before dispatch. Bit identity is to this specified rounded algorithm, not exact real arithmetic or other library reduction orders.
validation_method: Full byte comparison against independent exact-rational RN32 CPU oracle; analytic, adversarial and held-out vectors; arithmetic tested separately.

licensing_provenance.implementation: Original ASTRO implementation of published equations; no external code copied.

RT_applicability: Dense reductions, recurrences or all-pair output have no useful ray/BVH candidate pruning.
partition_strategy: independent trial periods, complete bins and width range
scientific_scope: Stated primitive only. Generated test vectors validate algorithms, not researcher-authorized live jobs.
